Connector php/elFinderConnector.class.php copies only commandArgsList keys into $args. At 2.1.66 (78488951e44d69e8b9e4e849f8268df408632a6c) resize accepts bg, php/elFinder.class.php sets $bg = $args['bg'], and volume resize() passes it to imgSquareFit (fitsquare) and imgRotate (rotate). ImageMagick CLI (imgLib convert) interpolates $bgcolor into sprintf 'xc:%s' (php/elFinderVolumeDriver.class.php:6173) and '-background "%s"' (line 6313) then procExec()/proc_open, so a crafted bg can inject shell commands as the web-server user. Crop/default resize do not take bg; the request-controlled sinks are fitsquare and rotate.
